sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS gross_revenue FROM sales;
select sum(revenue) from sales where has_customer_id = 1
SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT stock_code, description, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code, description ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT substr(invoice_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders FROM sales GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales
SELECT MIN(invoice_date), MAX(invoice_date) FROM sales
SELECT * FROM sales LIMIT 5
SELECT * FROM returns
SELECT invoice_no, quantity FROM sales WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-01-31' ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM sales ORDER BY country
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000
SELECT description FROM sales WHERE description LIKE '%HEART%' LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM sales WHERE country IN ('France', 'Germany') LIMIT 10
SELECT CASE WHEN revenue > 100 THEN 'large' ELSE 'small' END AS size, COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY size
SELECT ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2), CAST(SUM(quantity) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) FROM sales
SELECT COALESCE(customer_id, 'unknown') AS cust, SUM(revenue) FROM sales GROUP BY cust ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(return_value) FROM returns
SELECT (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales) - (SELECT SUM(return_value) FROM returns) AS net_revenue
WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month) SELECT month, revenue FROM monthly ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

WITH g AS (SELECT stock_code, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code), r AS (SELECT stock_code, SUM(return_value) AS ret FROM returns GROUP BY stock_code) SELECT g.stock_code, g.rev, COALESCE(r.ret, 0) AS ret FROM g LEFT JOIN r ON g.stock_code = r.stock_code ORDER BY g.rev DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT s.country, SUM(s.revenue) FROM sales AS s WHERE s.has_customer_id = 1 GROUP BY s.country
SELECT stock_code, revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM sales LIMIT 10
SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month)
SELECT invoice_no FROM sales UNION SELECT invoice_no FROM returns LIMIT 10
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 GROUP BY customer_id HAVING orders > 5 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT julianday(MAX(invoice_date)) - julianday(MIN(invoice_date)) FROM sales
SELECT date(invoice_date, 'start of month') AS m, COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY m
SELECT UPPER(country), LENGTH(description), TRIM(description) FROM sales LIMIT 3
SELECT description FROM sales WHERE description LIKE '%--%' LIMIT 3
why: '--' inside a string literal is not a comment

sql: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE description = 'x; DROP TABLE sales' LIMIT 3
SELECT "sales"."revenue" FROM "sales" LIMIT 3
SELECT * FROM sales LIMIT 100000
why: huge LIMIT gets wrapped and capped

sql: SELECT * FROM sales LIMIT -1
why: negative LIMIT gets wrapped and capped

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 AND country = 'France' AND invoice_date >= '2011-01-01'
why: AND chain (found missing by the gold-answer check)

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE country = 'France' OR country = 'Spain'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE (country = 'France' OR country = 'Spain') AND quantity > 5
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM sales s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM returns r WHERE r.country = s.country) ORDER BY country
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM sales s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM returns r WHERE r.country = s.country)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE customer_id IS NULL AND description IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM sales WHERE country NOT IN ('United Kingdom', 'EIRE') AND country NOT LIKE 'S%' ORDER BY country COLLATE NOCASE
why: NOT IN, NOT LIKE, COLLATE NOCASE

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= date('2011-03-01') AND invoice_date < date('2011-03-01', '+1 month')

SELECT CASE WHEN revenue < 10 THEN 'small' WHEN revenue < 100 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'large' END AS size_band, COUNT(*) AS line_count, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY size_band ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT country, SUM(CASE WHEN has_customer_id = 1 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS known_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN has_customer_id = 0 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS guest_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY country ORDER BY known_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', invoice_date) AS INTEGER) IN (0, 6) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY day_type
why: CASE with CAST, strftime and IN

sql: SELECT CASE country WHEN 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK' ELSE 'Other' END AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders FROM sales GROUP BY region
SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2011-06-01' AND '2011-06-30'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE unit_price BETWEEN 1 AND 2
SELECT stock_code, quantity FROM sales WHERE quantity NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE country IN ('France', 'Germany', 'Spain') GROUP BY country
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns WHERE stock_code IN (SELECT stock_code FROM sales WHERE revenue > 1000)
SELECT DISTINCT stock_code FROM sales WHERE stock_code IN ('85123A', '22423', '47566') ORDER BY stock_code
SELECT description, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales WHERE description LIKE '%LANTERN%' GROUP BY description ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) FROM sales WHERE stock_code LIKE '85%'
SELECT country FROM sales WHERE country LIKE 'S_ain' GROUP BY country
SELECT COALESCE(customer_id, 'GUEST') AS buyer, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM sales GROUP BY buyer ORDER BY line_count DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT stock_code, COALESCE(MAX(description), 'unknown') AS name, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(quantity), 0), 4) AS revenue_per_unit FROM sales
why: NULLIF to avoid divide by zero

sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0), 2) AS revenue_per_customer FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 GROUP BY country ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT CAST(SUM(revenue) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_whole FROM sales
SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', invoice_date) AS INTEGER) AS year, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM sales GROUP BY year
SELECT CAST(quantity AS REAL) / 12 AS dozens FROM sales LIMIT 5
SELECT CAST(customer_id AS INTEGER) AS id, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 GROUP BY id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) FROM sales
SELECT DISTINCT country, has_customer_id FROM sales ORDER BY country, has_customer_id LIMIT 20
SELECT stock_code, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code HAVING SUM(quantity) > 10000 ORDER BY units DESC
SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 GROUP BY country HAVING customers >= 50
SELECT invoice_no, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS order_value FROM sales GROUP BY invoice_no HAVING order_value > 5000 AND COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY order_value DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM sales)
SELECT country, revenue FROM (SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY country) WHERE revenue > 100000 ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT stock_code FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code HAVING SUM(revenue) > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code)) LIMIT 10

SELECT stock_code, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(return_value), 2) FROM returns r WHERE r.stock_code = t.stock_code) AS returned FROM (SELECT stock_code FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC LIMIT 5) t
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date)) >= 6)

SELECT month, revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS growth_pct FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month)
SELECT country, revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT country, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY country) LIMIT 10

SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS running_revenue FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month)

SELECT customer_id, invoice_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY invoice_date) AS visit_no FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, invoice_date FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1) LIMIT 10
SELECT stock_code, units, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY units DESC) AS quartile FROM (SELECT stock_code, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code) LIMIT 10

SELECT country, month, ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month), 2) AS share_pct FROM (SELECT country, strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY country, month) WHERE month = '2011-11' ORDER BY share_pct DESC LIMIT 5
why: share of total with window SUM

sql: SELECT strftime('%w', invoice_date) AS weekday, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY weekday
SELECT strftime('%H', invoice_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders FROM sales GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
SELECT date(MAX(invoice_date), '-30 days') AS thirty_days_before_end FROM sales
SELECT CAST(julianday(MAX(invoice_date)) - julianday(MIN(invoice_date)) AS INTEGER) AS days_covered FROM sales
SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', invoice_date) AS week, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY week ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT datetime(invoice_datetime, '+1 hour') AS shifted FROM sales LIMIT 3
SELECT 'sales' AS source, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*) FROM returns
SELECT country FROM sales INTERSECT SELECT country FROM returns ORDER BY country
SELECT stock_code FROM sales EXCEPT SELECT stock_code FROM returns LIMIT 10
SELECT customer_id FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 UNION SELECT customer_id FROM returns WHERE has_customer_id = 1

SELECT s.country, ROUND(s.sales_total, 2) AS sales, ROUND(COALESCE(r.returns_total, 0), 2) AS returns, ROUND(s.sales_total - COALESCE(r.returns_total, 0), 2) AS net FROM (SELECT country, SUM(revenue) AS sales_total FROM sales GROUP BY country) s LEFT JOIN (SELECT country, SUM(return_value) AS returns_total FROM returns GROUP BY country) r ON s.country = r.country ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 10
why: LEFT JOIN of two aggregates (net by country)

sql: SELECT s.stock_code, ROUND(100.0 * r.returned / s.sold, 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM (SELECT stock_code, SUM(quantity) AS sold FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code) s JOIN (SELECT stock_code, -SUM(quantity) AS returned FROM returns GROUP BY stock_code) r ON r.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE s.sold > 1000 ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) FROM sales s JOIN returns r ON s.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE s.has_customer_id = 1
why: customers who bought and returned (join on customer)

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales s JOIN returns r ON r.invoice_no = 'C' || s.invoice_no

WITH s AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS sales FROM sales GROUP BY month), r AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month, SUM(return_value) AS returns FROM returns GROUP BY month) SELECT s.month, ROUND(s.sales, 2) AS sales, ROUND(COALESCE(r.returns, 0), 2) AS returns, ROUND(s.sales - COALESCE(r.returns, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM s LEFT JOIN r ON r.month = s.month ORDER BY s.month

SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines, ROUND(SUM(s.revenue), 2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(r.return_value), 2) AS returned FROM sales s JOIN returns r ON s.stock_code = r.stock_code AND s.invoice_date = r.invoice_date WHERE s.stock_code = '22423'
why: aggregates over a join on product and date
